meta.title: Primary care access gap — Aravaipa corridor (1-hour drive)
meta.community: Aravaipa Canyon / eastern Pinal County, AZ
meta.description: Residents of the Aravaipa Canyon corridor are more than 1 hour's drive on paved roads from any primary care practice. Globe (northwest via AZ-77 + local roads) and Safford (east via US-191) are both 60-90 min away depending on exact location. Nearby towns Kearny, Winkelman, and Dudleyville are within 1 hour of Globe and fall outside the gap. Reference facilities shown as gray markers.
